layman_headline: Hyperliquid surges on Trump endorsement as crypto market rallies hard — adding to our ETH position.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market is ripping higher, with Bitcoin briefly touching $70K and Ethereum jumping 18%. Hyperliquid (HYPE) is one of the biggest movers, up 23% in a day after President Trump signaled the CFTC would create a legal path for Hyperliquid to operate in the US. This is a major regulatory catalyst that could drive sustained buying. Despite the big daily move, HYPE's RSI is only 53, meaning it still has room to run technically before becoming overbought.
layman_action: Consider adding a position in HYPE on any pullback toward $68. We're already holding ETH which is essentially flat from entry — keep that position with its existing stop-loss and target. Set a strict stop on HYPE at $61 to limit downside to roughly 15%.
expert_reasoning: HYPE presents the best risk/reward among candidates. The Trump/CFTC catalyst is a tier-1 regulatory event that typically drives multi-day momentum in crypto. RSI at 52.7 is remarkably neutral despite the 25.5% weekly move, indicating strong underlying demand absorbing supply. The coin is near ATH (-6.4%) which means minimal resistance overhead. Volume at $1.5B is institutional-grade. The main risk is a broader market reversal, but with BTC ETF inflows at $517M and short liquidations at $2.7B, the macro backdrop is supportive for at least the next several days. I'm targeting a pullback entry near $68 to improve risk/reward, with a stop at $61 (below pre-catalyst levels) and a target of $83 representing a new ATH push.
risk_factors: Broad market reversal if BTC fails to hold $68K — correlated selloff would hit HYPE hard
Regulatory catalyst could fizzle if CFTC process takes months or faces political opposition
High BTC dominance at 58.3% means capital is flowing to BTC over alts — headwind for HYPE
watch_list: BTC price action around $70K — a clean break above could fuel alt rotation, rejection would pressure HYPE
Any follow-up CFTC statements or regulatory filings regarding Hyperliquid's US access
ETH position — monitor for continuation toward $2,520 target or breakdown below $2,100
market_context: Massive broad-market rally with BTC hitting $70K, $2.7B in short liquidations, and $517M in BTC ETF inflows. Fear & Greed jumped from 46 to 62 in one day — sentiment shifted dramatically bullish but not yet euphoric.
context_banner: Crypto market surging on massive short squeeze and ETF inflows, with Hyperliquid receiving a unique regulatory tailwind from the White House.

key_signals.description: Bitcoin ETFs drew $517M and Ether ETFs $189M in biggest inflows in months, confirming institutional demand is surging behind this rally.
Trump signaled the CFTC is working to bring Hyperliquid to the US, providing a unique regulatory catalyst that directly benefits HYPE.
HYPE RSI at 52.7 despite a 25% weekly gain indicates strong absorption of selling pressure — room to run before overbought conditions.
Fear & Greed surged from 46 to 62 in 24 hours, confirming a rapid sentiment shift but not yet at dangerous euphoria levels.
HYPE trading $1.5B in 24h volume alongside ETH at $32.8B — institutional-grade liquidity confirming the breakout is real, not a thin-market spike.
